decided: orbit writes a change's account only into the change's own account folder, and refuses when that folder is a link to somewhere else, inside or outside the change's history, checking both when the folder is made and again just before writing.
alternatives: write to the folder's path as given, following any link
why: The decision records' folder already has this protection; without it the account folder would be the one place a link could send orbit's writes outside the change's history.

relies_on.title: Engine-owned spine composition and filename discipline
